user_saw: With both target flags set, an approvals command could report success after reading or changing the gateway policy while ignoring the named node.
summary: The approvals CLI now rejects simultaneous use of `--gateway` and `--node` before reading or writing policy.
reasoning: The July 1 snapshot already registered both flags and returned a null node ID whenever `--gateway` was set, routing reads and writes to the gateway. The offline path history stopped at a missing parent object, so I could not verify whether the behavior shipped with the target flags or was introduced later.
